This maintenance release fixes query, live-query, bulk-update, and database lifecycle edge cases; improves production bundler compatibility; makes Dexie Cloud sync retries recover faster; and restores compatibility with legacy Dexie exports.
- **Harden bulkUpdate()** — Changes to nested or compound primary keys now throw ConstraintError, and bulkUpdate() works when called before the database has opened. ([#2320](https://github.com/dexie/Dexie.js/pull/2320), [#2334](https://github.com/dexie/Dexie.js/pull/2

- **fix: avoid trailing commas in filtered chunked exports** — `exportDB()` no longer produces invalid JSON when a later chunk contains no rows matching the active filter. ([#2328](https://github.com/dexie/Dexie.js/pull/2328), fixes [#1070](https://github.com/dexie/Dexie.js/issues/1070)). Contributed by [@buildwithakhila](https://github.com/buildwithakhila).

- **fix: don't crash when an index is named `constructor`** — Tables with a primary key or index named `constructor` could cause `db.open()` to fail with `TypeError: indexList.push is not a function`. The internal index lookup now uses an object without a prototype, avoiding collisions with inherited `Object.prototype` properties such as `constructor`, `toString`, and `valueOf`. ([#2325](https://github.com/dexie/Dexie.js/pull/2325), fixes [#1920](https://github.com/dexie/Dexie.js/issues/1920)). Contribute

## What's Changed

* Downgrade PHP requirement from ^8.4 to ^8.3 by @erikn69 in https://github.com/spatie/db-dumper/pull/243

- Removed hidden `illuminate/support` dependency — `getSSLFlag()` no longer uses `DB::selectOne()` to auto-detect MySQL version. It now defaults to `ssl-mode=DISABLED` (works on MySQL 5.7.11+ and required for 8.4+). Use `setSslFlag('skip-ssl')` if you need the old flag for older MySQL versions.
- `includeRoutines()` method for MySQL and MariaDB to include stored procedures and functions in dumps
- `excludeTablesData()` method for MySQL and MariaDB to exclude data for specific tables while keeping their st

- **Keep a pre-upgrade backup for rollback.** Older binaries cannot read the new snapshot format or fully restore the new WAL metadata. See [recovery-format compatibility](https://github.com/orneryd/NornicDB/blob/v1.4.3/docs/operations/recovery-format-compatibility.md).
- **Go integrations:** remote query entities/paths now use `storage.RemoteEntityValue` / `storage.RemotePathValue`; projected graph properties retain their numeric/list types. Review direct type assertions. See [remote entity values](https:/

- **Dynamic labels, relationship types, and property keys:** Added `$(expr)`, `$all(expr)`, and `$any(expr)` in `MATCH`, `CREATE`, and `MERGE` patterns; `SET` / `REMOVE n:$(expr)`; and `SET n[key] = v` / `REMOVE n[key]`. Supported across `MERGE` actions and `FOREACH`, matching Neo4j 5.26 behavior. (#907)
- **Cypher 25 collection and string functions:** Added `coll.distinct`, `coll.flatten`, `coll.indexOf`, `coll.insert`, `coll.max`, `coll.min`, `coll.remove`, `coll.sort`, `string.indexOf`, `string.join`, `s

- **No breaking changes.** Existing Cypher 5 statements and NornicDB extensions continue to work unchanged.
NornicDB previously rejected `CYPHER 25`. This release adds the first implemented slice of the Cypher 25 conformance plan.
* fix(cypher): apoc.path.* and apoc.neighbors follow APOC 5.26 (start nodes, all settings, sequence, errors); add subgraphAll and expandConfig by @mm0nst3r in https://github.com/orneryd/NornicDB/pull/952
* Add Browser logout and responsive header by @rezamohamed in https://github.

- Label scans no longer read other databases' nodes (a 190× slowdown, #851), range scans stay inside their key range (after `DROP DATABASE`, `DETACH DELETE` of 100,000 nodes had gone from 6 s to 36 minutes, #850), and snapshot reads are 4–40× faster (#703).
- Statements of any size now commit atomically (#703), and `DROP DATABASE` completes for databases of any size (#819).

**Migration required:** Every deployment must supply a valid `organizationId`. Before upgrading, redeploy legacy projects with missing or invalid organization IDs and resolve project limit overrides without a deployment. V25 fails without changing the database if these preconditions are unmet; otherwise, it migrates overrides to organizations and drops the old project limits table.
Rename Helm `projectLimits` to `organizationLimits` and `DURABLE_ACTORS_PROJECT_*` settings to `DURABLE_ACTORS_ORGANIZATION_*`.

One design system, one source of truth.

- Every size on the site now comes from one set of scales: spacing, widths, type, corners, transitions and stacking.
- Five breakpoints instead of seventeen, so layouts switch at the same widths on every page.
- Type tidied: no half-pixel sizes, and weights match the font's real cuts.
- Nothing scrolls sideways anymore. The rank rail wraps, and wide tables on the legal pages turn into labelled rows on phones.
- Lesson drills no longer nudge the page while you type on

Pages show a skeleton preview while they load. A navigation still waiting on its data after 150 ms shows the shape of the next page, and the loading lines in history, results, the finger assessment, the finger map and games are now skeletons too.
